title: Webhook Verification Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the webhook signature verification policy. Enforces: constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks, replay protection window defined, signature verification required on all webhook endpoints.

error_codes.WV001: webhook-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: endpoints[], signatureHeader, algorithm, replayWindow
error_codes.WV002: Webhook signature comparison does not use constant-time equality — use crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks
error_codes.WV003: Replay protection window not defined — set replayWindowSeconds (recommended: 300) to reject replayed requests
error_codes.WV004: Webhook endpoint does not require signature verification — all webhook endpoints must verify HMAC signatures
error_codes.WV006: Webhook endpoint does not enforce TLS — all webhook receivers must use HTTPS to protect payloads in transit
